name: Oak Acorn
desc: From the old oak outside the Field Station. A charm for someone sturdy.

name: Four-Leaf Clover
desc: Pressed in 1987 and kept for someone who deserved it. A charm.

name: Brigid's Cross
desc: Woven from rushes. A charm against all sorts.

name: Horseshoe
desc: Off a pony who outlived three vicars. Luck clings to it. A charm.
